notes.title: The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
notes.notes:
The DEMO version of the latest work "Missile Dancer 2" has been released.
In the DEMO version, you can play Caravan mode (3 minute score attack).
If you like it, please add it to your wishlist and wait for the release of the product version.
Thank you for your continuous support. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566090/Missile_Dancer_2/
